title: Hearally audio ingest event, version 4
description: Sent by a paired collector to POST /v1/ingest after the audio has been put into S3 through a presigned POST from POST /v1/uploads. Audio never travels through the API. Both requests carry the computer's device token (Authorization: Bearer hd1.…; see collector-pairing.md). Version 4 removed account_id and object_key: the account is the one the computer was paired to, and the object is incoming/<account>/<event_id>, both derived by the server, so a collector cannot name another account or another account's audio. Enforced in backend/src/hearally/audio.py; this file documents it.

event_id.description: SHA-256 of the audio bytes, lowercase hex. The recording's identity, and the Idempotency-Key header must equal it.

byte_length.description: Must match the uploaded object, which the server checks with HeadObject before queueing.

recorded_at.description: ISO-8601 with a time zone. A naive time is refused, because quiet hours depend on it.

recorder_id.description: Optional. Which of the account holder's recorders made this recording; they may have several.

recorder_model.description: Optional. notepin and notepin_s cannot record phone calls, so capture_mode phone_call is refused for them.
